name: Wand of Secrets
summary: A wand that points to the nearest secret door or trap, using charges.

stats.effect: This wand has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge, and if a secret door or trap is within 60 feet of you, the wand pulses and points at the one nearest to you.
